metadata.description: The Microsoft Sentinel workspace into which the function will be deployed. Has to be in the selected Resource Group.
The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: Audit Event ASIM parser for AWS CloudTrail EC2 instance activity
properties.query:
let parser = (disabled: bool = false, pack: bool = false) {
  let Events = datatable(EventName: string, EventType: string, Object: string)
  [
    "AssociateApplicationStatusCheck", "Set", "Application Status Check Association",
    "AssociateIamInstanceProfile", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
    "AssociateInstanceEventWindow", "Set", "Instance Event Window",
    "CreateApplicationStatusCheck", "Create", "Application Status Check",
    "CreateInstanceEventWindow", "Create", "Instance Event Window",
    "DeleteApplicationStatusCheck", "Delete", "Application Status Check",
    "DeleteInstanceEventWindow", "Delete", "Instance Event Window",
    "DescribeApplicationStatus", "Read", "EC2 Instance Application Status",
    "DescribeApplicationStatusCheckAssociations", "Read", "Application Status Check Association",
    "DescribeApplicationStatusChecks", "Read", "Application Status Check",
    "DescribeIamInstanceProfileAssociations", "Read", "IAM Instance Profile Association",
    "DescribeInstanceAttribute", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
    "DescribeInstanceCreditSpecifications", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
    "DescribeInstanceEventNotificationAttributes", "Read", "Instance Event Notification Attribute",
    "DescribeInstanceEventWindows", "Read", "Instance Event Window",
    "DescribeInstanceImageMetadata", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
    "DescribeInstanceSqlHaHistoryStates", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
    "DescribeInstanceSqlHaStates", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
    "DescribeInstanceStatus", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
    "DescribeInstances", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
    "DisableApplicationStatusCheckSuppression", "Disable", "Application Status Check Suppression",
    "DisableInstanceSqlHaStandbyDetections", "Disable", "EC2 Instance",
    "DisassociateApplicationStatusCheck", "Delete", "Application Status Check Association",
    "DisassociateIamInstanceProfile", "Delete", "IAM Instance Profile Association",
    "DisassociateInstanceEventWindow", "Set", "Instance Event Window",
    "EnableApplicationStatusCheckSuppression", "Enable", "Application Status Check Suppression",
    "EnableInstanceSqlHaStandbyDetections", "Enable", "EC2 Instance",
    "GetDefaultCreditSpecification", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
    "GetInstanceMetadataDefaults", "Read", "Instance Metadata Defaults",
    "GetInstanceUefiData", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
    "ModifyApplicationStatusCheck", "Set", "Application Status Check",
    "ModifyDefaultCreditSpecification", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
    "ModifyInstanceAttribute", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
    "ModifyInstanceCapacityReservationAttributes", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
    "ModifyInstanceCpuOptions", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
    "ModifyInstanceCreditSpecification", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
    "ModifyInstanceEventStartTime", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
    "ModifyInstanceEventWindow", "Set", "Instance Event Window",
    "ModifyInstanceMaintenanceOptions", "Set", "IMDS",
    "ModifyInstanceMetadataDefaults", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
    "ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
    "ModifyInstanceNetworkPerformanceOptions", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
    "ModifyInstancePlacement", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
    "ModifyPrivateDnsNameOptions", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
    "ModifyPublicIpDnsNameOptions", "Set", "Network Interface",
    "MonitorInstances", "Execute", "EC2 Instance",
    "RebootInstances", "Execute", "EC2 Instance",
    "RegisterInstanceEventNotificationAttributes", "Create", "Instance Event Notification Attribute",
    "ReplaceIamInstanceProfileAssociation", "Set", "IAM Instance Profile Association",
    "ReportInstanceStatus", "Other", "EC2 Instance",
    "ResetInstanceAttribute", "Execute", "EC2 Instance",
    "RunInstances", "Start", "EC2 Instance",
    "SendDiagnosticInterrupt", "Execute", "EC2 Instance",
    "StartInstances", "Start", "EC2 Instance",
    "StopInstances", "Stop", "EC2 Instance",
    "TerminateInstances", "Stop", "EC2 Instance",
    "UnmonitorInstances", "Execute", "EC2 Instance"
  ];
  AWSCloudTrail
  | where not(disabled)
  | where EventSource == "ec2.amazonaws.com"
  | where EventName in (Events | project EventName)
  | lookup kind=inner Events on EventName
  | extend RequestParameters = todynamic(RequestParameters), ResponseElements = todynamic(ResponseElements)
  | extend EventResult = iff(isempty(ErrorCode) and isempty(ErrorMessage), "Success", "Failure")
  | extend NewValue = iff(EventResult == "Success", case(
      EventName == "AssociateApplicationStatusCheck", ResponseElements.successfulResultSet,
      EventName == "AssociateIamInstanceProfile", ResponseElements.iamInstanceProfileAssociation,
      EventName == "AssociateInstanceEventWindow", ResponseElements.instanceEventWindow,
      EventName == "CreateApplicationStatusCheck", ResponseElements.applicationStatusCheck,
      EventName == "CreateInstanceEventWindow", ResponseElements.instanceEventWindow,
      EventName == "DisableApplicationStatusCheckSuppression", ResponseElements.successfulResultSet,
      EventName == "EnableApplicationStatusCheckSuppression", ResponseElements.successfulResultSet,
      EventName == "ModifyApplicationStatusCheck", ResponseElements.applicationStatusCheck,
      EventName == "ModifyDefaultCreditSpecification", ResponseElements.instanceFamilyCreditSpecification,
      EventName == "ModifyInstanceAttribute", RequestParameters.Attribute,
      EventName == "ModifyInstanceCapacityReservationAttributes",
        RequestParameters.CapacityReservationSpecification,
      EventName == "ModifyInstanceCpuOptions", ResponseElements,
      EventName == "ModifyInstanceEventStartTime", ResponseElements.event,
      EventName == "ModifyPublicIpDnsNameOptions", RequestParameters.HostnameType,
      EventName == "MonitorInstances", ResponseElements.instancesSet,
      EventName == "RegisterInstanceEventNotificationAttributes", ResponseElements.instanceTagAttribute,
      EventName == "ReplaceIamInstanceProfileAssociation", ResponseElements.iamInstanceProfileAssociation,
      EventName == "RunInstances", ResponseElements.groupSet,
      EventName == "StartInstances", ResponseElements.instancesSet,
      EventName == "StopInstances", ResponseElements.instancesSet,
      EventName == "UnmonitorInstances", ResponseElements.instancesSet,
      ""
    ), "")
  | extend ObjectId = case(
      EventName == "AssociateApplicationStatusCheck", coalesce(RequestParameters.applicationStatusCheckId,
        RequestParameters.ApplicationStatusCheckId),
      EventName == "AssociateIamInstanceProfile", RequestParameters.InstanceId,
      EventName == "AssociateInstanceEventWindow", RequestParameters.InstanceEventWindowId,
      EventName == "CreateApplicationStatusCheck",
        ResponseElements.applicationStatusCheck.applicationStatusCheckId,
      EventName == "CreateInstanceEventWindow", ResponseElements.instanceEventWindow.instanceEventWindowId,
      EventName == "DeleteApplicationStatusCheck", coalesce(RequestParameters.applicationStatusCheckId,
        RequestParameters.ApplicationStatusCheckId),
      EventName == "DeleteInstanceEventWindow", RequestParameters.InstanceEventWindowId,
      EventName == "DescribeIamInstanceProfileAssociations", RequestParameters.AssociationId,
      EventName == "DescribeInstanceAttribute", RequestParameters.InstanceId,
      EventName == "DescribeInstanceCreditSpecifications", RequestParameters.InstanceId,
      EventName == "DescribeInstanceEventWindows", RequestParameters.InstanceEventWindowId.N,
      EventName == "DescribeInstanceImageMetadata", RequestParameters.InstanceId.N,
      EventName == "DescribeInstanceSqlHaHistoryStates", RequestParameters.InstanceId.N,
      EventName == "DescribeInstanceSqlHaStates", RequestParameters.InstanceId.N,
      EventName == "DescribeInstanceStatus", RequestParameters.InstanceId.N,
      EventName == "DescribeInstances", RequestParameters.InstanceId.N,
      EventName == "DisableInstanceSqlHaStandbyDetections", RequestParameters.InstanceId,
      EventName == "DisassociateApplicationStatusCheck", coalesce(RequestParameters.applicationStatusCheckId,
        RequestParameters.ApplicationStatusCheckId),
      EventName == "DisassociateIamInstanceProfile", RequestParameters.AssociationId,
      EventName == "DisassociateInstanceEventWindow", RequestParameters.InstanceEventWindowId,
      EventName == "EnableInstanceSqlHaStandbyDetections", RequestParameters.InstanceId,
      EventName == "GetInstanceUefiData", ResponseElements.instanceId,
      EventName == "ModifyApplicationStatusCheck", coalesce(RequestParameters.applicationStatusCheckId,
        RequestParameters.ApplicationStatusCheckId),
      EventName == "ModifyDefaultCreditSpecification",
        ResponseElements.instanceFamilyCreditSpecification.instanceFamilyCreditSpecificationId,
      EventName == "ModifyInstanceAttribute", RequestParameters.InstanceId,
      EventName == "ModifyInstanceCapacityReservationAttributes", RequestParameters.InstanceId,
      EventName == "ModifyInstanceCpuOptions", ResponseElements.instanceId,
      EventName == "ModifyInstanceCreditSpecification", RequestParameters.InstanceCreditSpecification,
      EventName == "ModifyInstanceEventStartTime", RequestParameters.InstanceEventId,
      EventName == "ModifyInstanceEventWindow", RequestParameters.InstanceEventWindowId,
      EventName == "ModifyInstanceMaintenanceOptions", ResponseElements.instanceId,
      EventName == "ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions", ResponseElements.instanceId,
      EventName == "ModifyInstanceNetworkPerformanceOptions", ResponseElements.instanceId,
      EventName == "ModifyInstancePlacement", ResponseElements.instanceId,
      EventName == "ModifyPrivateDnsNameOptions", RequestParameters.InstanceId,
      EventName == "ModifyPublicIpDnsNameOptions", RequestParameters.NetworkInterfaceId,
      EventName == "MonitorInstances", RequestParameters.InstanceId,
      EventName == "RebootInstances", RequestParameters.InstanceId,
      EventName == "ReplaceIamInstanceProfileAssociation",
        ResponseElements.iamInstanceProfileAssociation.associationId,
      EventName == "ReportInstanceStatus", RequestParameters.InstanceId,
      EventName == "ResetInstanceAttribute", RequestParameters.InstanceId,
      EventName == "RunInstances", ResponseElements.requesterId,
      EventName == "SendDiagnosticInterrupt", RequestParameters.InstanceId,
      EventName == "StartInstances", RequestParameters.InstanceId,
      EventName == "StopInstances", RequestParameters.InstanceId,
      EventName == "TerminateInstances", RequestParameters.InstanceId,
      EventName == "UnmonitorInstances", RequestParameters.InstanceId,
      ""
    )
  | extend
      Type = "AWSCloudTrail",
      EventCount = int(1),
      EventStartTime = TimeGenerated,
      EventEndTime = TimeGenerated,
      EventSeverity = "Informational",
      EventSchema = "AuditEvent",
      EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
      EventVendor = "AWS",
      EventProduct = "CloudTrail",
      Dvc = "CloudTrail",
      EventMessage = ErrorMessage,
      ObjectType = "Cloud Resource",
      TargetAppName = "Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud",
      TargetAppType = "Service"
  | project-rename
      EventOriginalSubType = EventTypeName,
      EventOriginalType = EventName,
      EventUid = AwsEventId,
      EventOriginalResultDetails = ErrorMessage,
      EventProductVersion = EventVersion,
      ActorUserId = UserIdentityAccountId,
      ActorUsername = UserIdentityUserName,
      ActorOriginalUserType = UserIdentityType,
      HttpUserAgent = UserAgent
  | extend
      ActorUserIdType = iff(isempty(ActorUserId), "", "AWSId"),
      ActorUsernameType = iff(isempty(ActorUsername), "", "Simple"),
      SrcIpAddr = iff(ipv4_is_in_range(SourceIpAddress, "0.0.0.0/0"), SourceIpAddress, ""),
      ActingApplicationEntityKey = "",
      ActorUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
      ActorUserEntityKey = "",
      AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
      DvcEntityKey = "",
      SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
      TargetApplicationEntityKey = "",
      TargetSystemEntityKey = ""
  | extend AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_pack(
      "ActorAccessKeyId", UserIdentityAccessKeyId,
      "AWSRegion", AWSRegion,
      "APIVersion", APIVersion,
      "ManagementEvent", ManagementEvent,
      "ReadOnly", ReadOnly,
      "RequestParameters", RequestParameters,
      "ResponseElements", ResponseElements
    ), dynamic({}))
  | extend
      Operation = EventOriginalType,
      User = ActorUsername,
      IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
      Application = TargetAppName,
      Value = NewValue
  | project
      TimeGenerated, Type, EventCount, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventSeverity,
      EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion, EventVendor, EventProduct, Dvc, EventResult,
      EventMessage, TargetAppName, EventOriginalSubType, EventOriginalType, EventUid,
      EventOriginalResultDetails, EventProductVersion, ActorUserId, ActorUsername,
      ActorOriginalUserType, HttpUserAgent, ActorUserIdType, ActorUsernameType,
      SrcIpAddr, AdditionalFields, User, IpAddr, Application, EventType, NewValue,
      Value, ObjectId, ObjectType, Object, TargetAppType, Operation,
      ActingApplicationEntityKey, ActorUserAdditionalIds, ActorUserEntityKey,
      AdditionalEntities, DvcEntityKey, SrcSystemEntityKey,
      TargetApplicationEntityKey, TargetSystemEntityKey
};
parser(disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
